output_list.criticism: The totalSupply function does not check for overflow when adding the total supply to the balances mapping. This could lead to an integer overflow if the total supply is too large.
The transfer function does not check for overflow when adding the amount to the recipient's balance. This could lead to an integer overflow if the amount is too large.
The transferFrom function does not check for overflow when adding the amount to the recipient's balance. This could lead to an integer overflow if the amount is too large.
The approve function does not check for overflow when setting the allowance. This could lead to an integer overflow if the allowance is too large.
The increaseApproval function does not check for overflow when adding the added value to the allowance. This could lead to an integer overflow if the added value is too large.
